B2 Read it in

read_all_hh <- function(zip_dir = "data/raw", pattern = "FLUXNET.*\\.zip$") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr) 
  
  keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
            "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
            "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

  
  zip_files <- list.files(zip_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(zip_files) == 0) {
    stop("No zipfiles in folder.")
  }
  

  hh_list <- lapply(zip_files, function(zip_file) {
    hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
    unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped")
    
    site_id <- sub(".*_(.*?)_FLUXNET.*", "\\1", basename(zip_file))
    
    read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
             na = "-9999",
             col_select = any_of(keep),
             col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d")) |>
      mutate(
        time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
        ID = site_id
      )
  })
  
  
  Alltowers <- bind_rows(hh_list)
  
  return(Alltowers)
}

Alltowers <- read_all_hh()

Alltowers[Alltowers == -9999] <- NA

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

world <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey92",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = stations,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    colour = "red3",
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = stations,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = ID),
    size = 3.5,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 42
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    ratio = 1,
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(-60, 80),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Flux-tower locations",
    x = "Longitude (°)",
    y = "Latitude (°)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "aliceblue",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

library(ggplot2)

Alltowers <- Alltowers %>%

Alltowers_summary <- Alltowers %>% 
  group_by(ID, year) %>% 
  summarise(share_measured = mean(NEE_VUT_REF_QC == 0, na.rm = TRUE))

Summary statistics

summary_table <- Alltowers %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(c(TA_F, SW_IN_F, VPD_F, NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_NT_VUT_REF, H_F_MDS, LE_F_MDS), 
           list(
             Mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Missing_pct = ~ sum(is.na(.x)) / n() * 100
           ), .names = "{.col} ({.fn})"),
    P_F_annual_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE) * 24 * 365,
    P_F_min = min(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_max = max(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_missing_pct = sum(is.na(P_F)) / n() * 100

4. Time Series of NEE, GPP and Reco

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

Alltowers_daily <- Alltowers %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd_hm(TIMESTAMP_START)) %>% 
  group_by(date = as.Date(date), ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    NEE_daily = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    GPP_daily = mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    RECO_daily = mean(RECO_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

Alltowers_daily_long <- Alltowers_daily %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NEE_daily, GPP_daily, RECO_daily), 
               names_to = "Variable", 
               values_to = "Value")
#|fig-width: 10
#|fig-height: 5

ggplot(Alltowers_daily_long, aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Variable)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.05) + 
  facet_wrap(~ ID) + 
  labs(title = "Daily NEE, GPP, and RECO", 
       x = "Date", 
       y = "g C m⁻² d⁻¹") + 
  theme_minimal()

6

Alltowers <- Alltowers %>%
  left_join(
    stations %>%
      select(ID, lat, lon),
    by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(
    time = ymd_hm(TIMESTAMP_START),
    hour = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60,
    month = month(time))

Alltowers <- Alltowers %>%
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(time),

    season = case_when(
      is.na(lat) ~ NA_character_,

      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn",

      lat < 0 & month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    ),

    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
    )
  )

hourly_long <- Alltowers %>%
  filter(!is.na(season)) %>%
  group_by(ID, season, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
    LE  = mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NEE, LE),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )
#|fig-width: 10
#|fig-height: 5
ggplot( hourly_long, aes(x = hour, y = value, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ season, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 24, 6),
    limits = c(0, 24)) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Mean flux (NEE: µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹; LE: W m⁻²)",
    colour = "Site",
    title = "Mean daily course of NEE and LE by season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

I added the latitude of each site from the stations table using the site ID. I used latitude to check whether each site is north or south of the equator: positive values mean north and negative values mean south. I assigned seasons based on the month, reversing them for sites in the Southern Hemisphere. Like that, December–February is winter in the Northern Hemisphere but summer in the Southern Hemisphere.

energy_data <- Alltowers %>%
  filter(
    H_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    LE_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    is.finite(H_F_MDS),
    is.finite(LE_F_MDS),
    is.finite(NETRAD),
    is.finite(G_F_MDS)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    available_energy = NETRAD - G_F_MDS,
    turbulent_flux = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS
  )


energy_site <- energy_data %>%
  filter(ID == "US-Ro5")

fit <- lm(turbulent_flux ~ available_energy, data = energy_site)
summary(fit)

Not all of the available energy goes into latent and sensible heat flux. Some of the energy will i.e. be reflected (Albedo) or used for photosynthesis.

annual_carbon <- Alltowers %>%
  group_by(ID, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_times = n_distinct(time),
    n_NEE = sum(is.finite(NEE_VUT_REF)),
    NEE_gC_m2_year = sum(
      NEE_VUT_REF * 1800 * 12.011 / 1e6,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_half_hours = if_else(
      leap_year(year), 366L, 365L
    ) * 48L,
    complete_year =
      n_rows == expected_half_hours &
      n_times == expected_half_hours &
      n_NEE == expected_half_hours
  )

print(annual_carbon)

carbon_summary <- annual_carbon %>%
  filter(complete_year) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_complete_years = n(),
    mean_annual_NEE = mean(NEE_gC_m2_year),
    mean_annual_uptake = -mean_annual_NEE,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_annual_uptake))
monthly_NEE <- Alltowers %>%
  filter(is.finite(NEE_VUT_REF)) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    monthly_NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_monthly_NEE = mean(monthly_NEE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

seasonal_summary <- monthly_NEE %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_months = n(),
    seasonal_amplitude = if (n() == 12L) {
      max(mean_monthly_NEE) - min(mean_monthly_NEE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
gap_summary <- Alltowers %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    NEE_value = NEE_VUT_REF,
    NEE_qc = NEE_VUT_REF_QC,
    LE_value = LE_F_MDS,
    LE_qc = LE_F_MDS_QC,
    H_value = H_F_MDS,
    H_qc = H_F_MDS_QC
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(NEE|LE|H)_(value|qc)"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_missing = sum(!is.finite(value)),
    n_classified = sum(
      is.finite(value) & qc %in% 0:3
    ),
    n_gapfilled = sum(
      is.finite(value) & qc %in% 1:3
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gapfilled_percent = if_else(
      n_classified > 0,
      100 * n_gapfilled / n_classified,
      NA_real_
    ),
    missing_percent = 100 * n_missing / n_total
  )

comparison <- carbon_summary %>%
  full_join(seasonal_summary, by = "ID") %>%
  left_join(
    gap_summary %>%
      filter(variable == "NEE") %>%
      select(ID, NEE_gapfilled_percent = gapfilled_percent),
    by = "ID"
  )

print(comparison)

The site in Japan (JP-Ta2) has the strongest carbon uptake of all ecosystems. As an evergreen needleleaf forest this makes sense and alligns with the NEE plots on FLuxnet site explorer showing negative NEE values (carbon uptake) almost without seasonal carbon release as would be expected from broadleaf forests. The Germany site (De-Hzd) which is a broadleaf forest shows much lower carbon uptake. That might be due to heat and drought events in central Europe (especially eastern Germany) of the last 10 years. The US site (Us-Ro5) shows the strongest seasonal amplitude which makes sense because it is the only cropland area of the 5 sites showing strong uptake in the growing season and low - no carbon release after harvest. For all 5 towers at between 45 - 70 % of the data is gap-filled.66 and 69 % of gap-filling in Germany and Japan suggests some trouble with data aquisition for those towers.
